documents.title: Marriage-contract condition assistance
documents.subtitle: Tell us about your situation and the conditions you'd like considered, and we'll help draft them for your lawyer's review.
documents.situationPlaceholder: e.g. My fiancée and I would like to document a few specific conditions before signing the contract.
documents.conditionsPlaceholder: e.g. continuing my work after marriage, an independent residence, part of the dowry recorded as deferred.
documents.factsPlaceholder: Details that help your lawyer draft this precisely.
documents.pendingReviewBody: This draft has not been released yet. A licensed lawyer reviews it before it reaches you — this reflects the per-instance review model used for any condition with financial or custodial impact.
documents.templateApprovedBody: This template and the logic that filled it in were already thoroughly reviewed and approved by a licensed lawyer.
documents.demoToggleNote: This toggle is for demonstration only, to show both possible states — the actual default is "pending review."
documents.najizTitle: What happens next: the Najiz platform
documents.najizBody: The marriage contract itself is finalized exclusively by the Ministry of Justice through the Najiz platform, executed by an official marriage officer (ma'zoun). This app does not issue the marriage contract or replace that government process — its role is only to help prepare the conditions and documents you bring to it.
documents.najizCta: Learn more about the Najiz process
